item.text:
# Release notes — replay harness This run exercises **every item type** the display can see: prose with `inline code`, links, lists, tables, fenced code, inline SVG, raw HTML and mermaid. ## Highlights - Markdown paragraphs wrap normally, including a very long line below. - Nested lists: - first level - second level with a [link to the docs](https://example.com/docs "Docs") - `code_span()` inside a list item 1. ordered child 2. another ordered child - Blockquote: > Replay fixtures are stdout, not mocks: the box pipes these lines through the real harness parser. ### Changed 1. `AgentItem` union now carries tool status and turn usage. 2. The app renders agent text as markdown with raw HTML allowed. 3. Turn items show wall-clock duration when the harness reports one. | Area | Change | Risk | | --- | --- | --- | | Protocol | new `agent.item` event | low | | Box | replay script + fixtures | dev-only | | App | markdown renderer, tool cards | medium — untrusted HTML | ```ts export const greet = (name: string): string => `Hello, ${name}!` type Item = { id: string; parentToolId: string | null } ``` ```python def greet(name: str) -> str: return f"Hello, {name}!" print(greet("Ada")) ``` ```bash bun run typecheck && bun test packages/server ``` ```json {"type":"turn.completed","usage":{"input_tokens":29340,"output_tokens":348}} ``` Inline SVG (should render as an image, not text): Raw HTML block:
